speaker: PORT AUTHORITY
text: Keeping the port here avoids the enormous cost of constructing a new port.

speaker: PORT AUTHORITY
text: However, vessels will have to adapt to the new routes created by the wind park.

speaker: PORT AUTHORITY
text: This will increase operating costs and could gradually weaken our competitive position.

speaker: ENERGY MINISTER
text: At least we can avoid the major financial burden of relocating the port.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: The decision therefore protects public finances in the short term, but leaves the port exposed to long-term economic pressure.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: Arcadia has accepted some economic consequences for the port in order to avoid the cost and disruption of relocation.
